notes.title: Sortie de la démo Show Quiz le 9 Juin !
notes.content:
Oyez Oyez!

We're almost there! The playable demo of [b]Show Quiz[/b] will be available from [u][b]June 9[/b][/u] on Steam!

At last, you'll be able to try out for yourself this fast-paced quiz game, designed to put your knowledge to the test in a fun, competitive atmosphere. Over 60,000 questions await you in this first version, and that's just for starters!

This demo will also enable me to correct certain questions and recalibrate their difficulty!

Feedback? An idea to suggest? A bug to report? Or even a question to add?
Join the game's Discord server here:
[url=https://discord.gg/2Npe2eBRM4]https://discord.gg/2Npe2eBRM4[/url]


It's the ideal place to discuss the game, share your suggestions, ask questions or help improve Show Quizz for its final version!

Thank you all for your support, and see you soon to test your knowledge!

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Arrivée de Show Quiz sur Steam !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575202/205e2bd462b71f4c78dbe5badd33e7008555e32e.png[/img]

[h1]Hear ye! Hear![/h1]
I'm proud to be able to publish Show Quiz on steam! 
Scheduled for release in 2025. 

What's coming out: 
[list]
[*] 5000+ questions to test your knowledge!
[*] An xp system to unlock new game modes!
[*] A rank to display your ratio of correct answers to questions asked!
[*] Game modes based on question difficulty.
[*] An “infinite” game mode where you'll pass over every question in the game.
[*] A survival mode where you're only allowed 3 mistakes (infinite time and infinite questions).
[/list]


But that's not all!
I'm also planning a 2.0 version of the game! 

This version will feature multiplayer. 
However, a paying DLC (5€) will allow those who acquire it to host as many games as they wish.
Joining games will remain free for anyone.

On that note, feel free to [b]wishlist[/b] my game to support me. 

Thanks to all those who have helped me make my game a reality so far!
